rationale: Surge rose 1.2x -> 1.5x and the notice came at 18:29:30, after pickup at 18:27:00: not notified under SURGE-1 -> refund the surge differential (SURGE-2). Differential = (1.5 − 1.2) × surgeable subtotal $11.29 = $3.39; the booking fee is not surged (SURGE-3). The fare is only $2.56 above the quote (the trip ran shorter than the estimate), so the refund is capped at $2.56. A party carries a fraud flag, so the threshold is 95%; code confidence 97% meets it and the profile does not decide the case (TH-3).
